summary: Blackstone Private Real Estate Credit & Income Fund (the Fund) and its subsidiary BREC Holdings, LP entered into a $150M revolving credit facility with Wells Fargo as administrative agent, filed on Form 8-K. The facility matures April 2029, with an accordion feature up to $160M or 20% of NAV. Borrowings bear interest at SOFR plus 2.40% or base rate plus 1.40%, with a 0.35% unused fee. Proceeds support general corporate purposes. This is a routine financing agreement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change is involved. The filing discloses a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation. The terms are standard for a credit facility with no special-situation catalysts.
